notes: MLCommons ml_spoken_words (Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus) — 1-second real keyword-clip recordings, HF parquet-convert mirror (refs/convert/parquet, config 'pt_wav', split 'partial-test' — the smallest available partial split; the base repo ships a loading script and is not viewer/streamable, so the auto-converted parquet mirror is the only fetchable form). Registered as a hard-negative source for the wake_word league: real short keyword clips in this language that MUST NOT trigger any wake-word engine, a harder false-accept test than synthetic or ambient-noise negatives. role=unrestricted (openly-available supplementary corpus, not itself a positive/negative eval set) — NOT yet wired into any fighter's negatives_sources: the wake_word league's negatives-pooling code (runner.audio_io._pool_negatives / stream_ww) lists individual audio files in a repo tree (huggingface_hub.list_repo_files), which only works for audiofolder-shaped corpora; this corpus ships audio embedded in parquet row groups, consumable only via runner.audio_io.stream_audio_dataset (the HF-parquet path used by STT/VAD positives). Wiring it into the wake-word false-accept pool needs a parquet-aware negatives adapter — left as follow-up, documented rather than silently forced.
